provenance.source: NISR EICV7 2023/24 cross-section (licensed microdata, aggregate output only)
provenance.derivedFrom: Household cross-section poverty, strata and VUP module files (paths held in the local build, not published)

method.estimator: engine/ireme/survey.py Taylor-series linearisation under stratified multistage cluster design (strata_id, clust)
method.povertyUniverse: Person universe: weights are pop_wt, the estimate is the share of people in poor households. Denominator is the weighted person population.
method.vupUniverse: Household universe: weights are the household weight, restricted to surveyed poor households. Denominator is weighted poor households, NOT people.

intervalMethod.poverty: Student t on design degrees of freedom
intervalMethod.vup: Korn-Graubard style logit interval on design degrees of freedom

method.degreesOfFreedom: n_PSU - n_strata for the full design, the standard subdomain approach; domain sample and PSU counts are reported per geography.
method.contrast: District versus national difference uses the joint design covariance (survey.difference_estimate), not interval overlap.
method.reliability: survey.reliability_grade with minimum 30 observations and 5 PSUs per domain; bands CV<15% high, <30% moderate, otherwise low.
method.notIncluded: Rank separation is not computed: ordering districts by point estimate does not establish real rank differences without a resampled rank distribution.

status.note: Computed by the repository's primary estimator from licensed EICV7 microdata. Independent scientific review of method, tolerances and publication decision is outstanding; these intervals are not an NISR-certified publication.

reliabilityBands.unreliable: Domain below the minimum observations or PSUs
reliabilityBands.unestimable: Variance not estimable for this domain
